update-23-0-0-migrate-create-nodes-v2-im.description: Rename imports of `createNodesV2` from `@nx/playwright/plugin` to the canonical `createNodes` export.

remove-deprecated-executors.description: Converts targets using the removed `@nx/playwright` executors to inferred tasks; an AI prompt finishes the targets the converter cannot convert safely and validates the project graph.

update-24-0-0-disable-wait-for-server-re.description: Sets `waitForServerReady: false` on `@nx/playwright/plugin` entries in `nx.json` so existing Playwright e2e tasks keep starting without waiting for the dev server to report it is ready.
